name: music-prompt-v1

fields.label: コンセプト
fields.default: Late-night city drive with a quiet sense of hope

fields.label: 構成
fields.default: intro, verse, chorus, bridge, final chorus
options: short intro, main loop, subtle outro
intro, verse, chorus, bridge, final chorus
A section, B section, dynamic return
DJ-friendly intro, drop, breakdown, second drop

fields.label: 歌詞の方向性
fields.default: If vocals are used, write concise Japanese lyrics about neon reflections, distance, and a promise that still feels possible.
fields.placeholder: 歌詞テーマ、言語、避けたい表現

fields.label: ミックス
fields.default: Polished stereo mix, punchy low end, smooth high frequencies, wide pads, clear lead elements, no harshness.

fields.label: 避ける要素
fields.default: muddy low end, distorted vocals, abrupt transitions, overly busy arrangement, comedic sound effects
fields.placeholder: 入れたくない音や雰囲気

values.concept: Late-night city drive with a quiet sense of hope
values.structure: intro, verse, chorus, bridge, final chorus

presets.label: Lo-fi Study
presets.description: 小さめ、落ち着き、ループ

values.concept: A quiet study desk on a rainy afternoon
values.structure: short intro, main loop, subtle outro
values.mix_direction: Warm tape texture, soft transients, rounded bass, gentle vinyl noise, relaxed stereo image.
values.avoid: sharp snares, dramatic risers, busy melodies, bright EDM synths

values.concept: A final sunrise after a long journey
values.mix_direction: Wide cinematic image, deep but controlled percussion, expressive strings, gradual automation, clear emotional peak.
values.avoid: trailer hit overload, synthetic choir artifacts, muddy reverb tail

values.concept: A bright festival set that lifts the room at midnight
values.structure: DJ-friendly intro, drop, breakdown, second drop
values.mix_direction: Club-ready low end, crisp percussion, wide supersaw layers, strong sidechain movement, clean drop impact.
values.avoid: thin kick, harsh synth highs, random fills, weak transition into the drop
